title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft FSCM → Expenses

source_tables.description: Expense report header. Employee, business purpose, dates, status, total.
Expense report lines. Individual expenses with type, amount, date, receipt.
Expense distribution. Chartfield coding for each expense line.
Expense accounting. GL entries generated from approved expense reports.
Cash advance header. Pre-trip advance requests.
Expense type definitions. Airfare, hotel, meals, mileage, registration, supplies.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Array: {expense_type, description, date, amount, receipt_flag, merchant_name, payment_type ('personal', 'corporate_card', 'prepaid')}.
Chartfield coding per line: {account, fund, department, project_id, amount}.
Cash advance amount. Net reimbursement = total_amount - advance_amount.

notes: Travel and expense is a high-volume, high-visibility module. Higher ed institutions often have complex travel policies (state per diem rates, pre-approval requirements, grant-funded travel restrictions). Expenses charged to federal grants must comply with 2 CFR 200 (reasonable, allowable, allocable). Corporate card reconciliation typically flows through PS_EX_SHEET_LINE.
